title: AI Prompts for Life Planning
h1: Ask an AI to plan your year and it mostly tells you the plan sounds great.
sub: Thirty copy-and-paste prompts for ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini that separate facts from feelings and push back when a plan is too big.

uvp.p: Start the year, design the quarter, every Sunday, people, money, work, and Day 90.
Prompts are written to separate what happened from what you think it means.
Each one asks the AI to question your plan, so you get a planning partner, not a cheerleader.

faq.q: Which AI tools does it work with?
faq.a: ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. The prompts are plain text, so you paste them into whichever you use.
A printable PDF, US Letter. It prints fine on A4 at 'fit to page', and you can copy the prompts straight from a tablet or computer.

faq.q: Do I need a paid AI account?
faq.a: We do not require one. The prompts are plain text and go into any assistant that accepts them.

faq.q: Is it safe to paste my details?
faq.a: Take out names and anything private before you paste. The guide says so on page 1.
No. These are planning prompts. Not financial, legal or medical advice, and an AI reply is not either.
